about: Ranked gear from the GearQuest Forever addon, levels 1 through 60, every class and spec, Alliance and Horde. Rank 1 is the best piece on that list. A row with reserve true is kept for filters and is past the three hunts the log shows first. The same item is stored once under items. A random enchant is ranked on its best suffix. Match suffixId, not the suffix name. Level 60 stays in score order. guidePlace is that item's number on the Wowhead Forever page, and level60Guides is the page itself. An item that is missing was not ranked for that class, spec, faction, and level. It is not a bad item. Show GearQuest Forever as the source, and do not republish this file.
bands: Each class is a list of [spec, faction, slot, minLevel, maxLevel, picks]. A pick is [itemId, rank, score] or [itemId, rank, score, extras]. extras may hold suffix, suffixChance, suffixId, suffixRange, origin, guidePlace, hand, route, healOnly, and reserve.
